designRule: Preserve the Pale Guest's identity, AC, core actions, and multiple victory methods. Scale action-economy pressure and ritual assistance, not arbitrary boss HP.

adjustments: Caldus can assist the binding if alive and not hostile: once per round he may use his action to count as one successful ritual contribution instead of attacking.
The first failed ritual check each round does not advance Unstable Binding; later failures that round work normally.
partyScaling.gmCue: Small party: preserve the boss, give the heroes breathing room to use the non-damage victory routes.

adjustments: Run the encounter exactly as written in the Adventure Package.

At initiative count 20, after the first round, one unoccupied ritual sigil flares. One creature within 10 feet of that sigil must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity save or take 1d6 force damage and be pushed 5 feet.
A character adjacent to the sigil can use an action to suppress that flare until the next round with a DC 12 Arcana or Religion check.
partyScaling.gmCue: Large party: add positional pressure, not hit points.

adjustments: At initiative count 20, a second different unoccupied sigil flares. Resolve each flare separately; a creature can be affected by only one flare per round.
If the party has already completed the new binding, stop all sigil flares immediately.
partyScaling.gmCue: Six heroes get more simultaneous battlefield problems, never an HP sponge.

routePressure.graveyardRoute: If the party reaches the finale visibly depleted, do not add punishment beyond the party-size rule. Preserve the non-damage victory routes and Caldus assistance where earned.
routePressure.culvertRoute: The shortcut intentionally preserves more resources. Do not compensate by secretly increasing boss statistics; the players earned that advantage by finding and using the route.
